description:
# LSC-01 | Fun 001 | Queue Luma Guest for SF Campaign Sync

**📋 Ticket:** [Luma guests → Salesforce campaign members](https://brightdata-group.monday.com/boards/8667788707/pulses/13343839880)

---

**TRIGGER:** Called async by `Webhook: Luma-to-HubSpot Guest Sync` (end of the not-ignored path)

**PURPOSE:** Queue every Luma guest registration for the hourly Salesforce campaign sync.

**FLOW:**
1. Look up the row by `luma_guest_id` + `luma_url_slug` → PostgreSQL
2. Exists → re-queue (Pending, attempts 0, `next_attempt_at` = now + 1h); else insert

**DB / TABLES:** `marketing.luma_sf_campaign_queue` (read/write)
**UPSTREAM:** Webhook: Luma-to-HubSpot Guest Sync  
**DOWNSTREAM:** none

## Important logic
- One row per guest + event (unique key). A webhook retry or status change re-queues the same row.
- First sync attempt 1h after the last webhook, so HubSpot → SF can create the Lead.
- Fire-and-forget: calls System Error Handling itself on failure.
